purpose: Sanitized deterministic examples for the ZenABM trial-to-value workflow.

sourceLabels.zenabm_trial: Sanitized ZenABM trial and performance context.
sourceLabels.linkedin_public_ads: Public LinkedIn ad-library observation; never treated as spend, clicks, creative text, or hidden targeting.
sourceLabels.hubspot_trial: Sanitized trial-contact consent and lifecycle context.

commonFields.trial: Selected trial identity, status, and consent state.
commonFields.competitor: Candidate competitor with a canonical LinkedIn company ID only when verified.
commonFields.coverage: Visibility scope; unavailable measurements must be represented as unknown.
commonFields.evidence: Source-labelled references supporting a finding or action.
commonFields.outcome: Deterministic acceptance, rejection, or no-draft policy result.

cases.purpose: Allow an evidence-linked, human-reviewed action for a canonically verified competitor.
Preserve unknown coverage and avoid numerical or causal claims.
Reject a fuzzy advertiser match without a canonical LinkedIn company ID.
Suppress both draft creation and every send action for an opted-out contact.
Stop before analysis or drafts when the selected trial is not active.
Fail closed when the selected contact is suppressed.
Fail closed when marketing eligibility is missing or unknown.
